label: CCR2004-1G-12S+2XS
description: MikroTik CCR2004-1G-12S+2XS - cloud core router: 1x 1G RJ45, 12x 10G SFP+ cages and 2x 25G SFP28 cages, quad-core ARM AL32400.
notes: The 12 template ports are declared sfp+ explicitly: at 10G both copper (10GBASE-T) and fibre (SFP+) are common, so the connector must not be guessed from the rate.
